title: Quantik engine response v2
description: JSON response body for an engine service's chosen move (engine-response.v2). Extends engine-response.v1 (which stays frozen) with ranked candidates, a principal variation, an optional engine_config, and a required certainty (estimate | proof) that qualifies every number in the body. See docs/engine-response-v2.md.

engine_version.description: The versioned artefact that decided the move: model_id for checkpoint-backed engines, the quantik-core revision (or installed release string) for pure-core engines. Never an opponent id or a config string. Not comparable as strings across implementations.

certainty.description: Required. 'proof' only when every number in the response is proven (exhaustive search or exact oracle); a network output, MCTS or beam value is always 'estimate'. Qualifies value, policy, every candidate score and pv.

value.description: Optional mover-relative expected result in [-1, 1]; 1 is a forced win for the side to move at the root.

policy.description: Optional 64-slot action-indexed prior; slot i is action i. Unchanged from v1.

candidates.description: Optional ranked subset of the legal moves, best first (rank is the array index; never re-sort across units). Not a partition of the legal set. Action indices should be unique (checked by scripts/validate_contracts.py).

score.description: In the engine's own unit, not normalised.

pv.description: Optional principal variation: flat action indices, pv[0] equals action_index (checked by scripts/validate_contracts.py), later entries alternate sides. Omitted, never empty. Inherits the response's certainty.

engine_config.description: Optional free-text strength-relevant configuration not part of the artefact (for example 'depth=2'). For humans and pooling keys: consumers key on (engine_kind, engine_version, engine_config) and never parse it.
